description: For total computable \(g\) reducing \(K_z\) to an arbitrary \(C\subseteq\mathbb N\), and fixed indices satisfying both selector rules, the specified \(b\) is total computable and injective and satisfies \(e\in K_z\Longleftrightarrow b(e)\in C\). No enumerability or computability assumption on \(C\) is required.
